```{r}
#| include: true
if (!exists("TR.target") || !length(TR.target)) TR.target <- TR.gmdp
if (!exists("IDg.target") || !length(IDg.target)) IDg.target <- IDg.gmdp
if (!exists("Da.target") || !length(Da.target))  Da.target  <- sort(Da.gmdp)
if (!exists("MODELS", inherits = FALSE)) MODELS <- c(rigid = "Rigid Models", flexible = "Flexible Models", ensemble = "Ensemble Models")
if (!exists("IDn.target") || !length(IDn.target)) IDn.target <- names(MODELS)
MODELS <- MODELS[names(MODELS) %in% IDn.target]
if (!exists("p.target") || !length(p.target))   p.target   <- "mean"
PSA_Units <- "cm/s2"
root <- here::here()
if (!exists("CAP", inherits = FALSE)) CAP <- readCaption("tbl.kmax")
SiteID.caption <- .requireOneTarget(
  .currentTarget("siteID.target"), "siteID.target", "kmax table caption"
)
```

:::{.panel-tabset .full-width}

```{r}
#| eval: !expr knitr::is_html_output()
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
for (IDn in names(MODELS)) {
  cat("\n#### ", MODELS[[IDn]], "\n\n", sep = "")
  cat("::: {.panel-tabset .full-width}\n\n")
  for (IDmTab in IDm.gmdp) {
    cat("\n##### ", IDmTab, "\n\n", sep = "")
    NGR::knitBlock(path = "/_tbl/kmax.IDg.qmd", stem = .composeTargetStem(paste(c("kmax", tolower(IDn), "idm", tolower(IDmTab)), collapse = "-")), labels = "rewrite", vars = list(IDn.target = IDn, IDm.target = IDmTab), root = root)
  }
  cat("\n:::\n")
}
rm(IDn, IDmTab)
```
